findings.location: Q09 option D; Q10 option C, DE/EN/FA
findings.observed: Hydrostatic oedema does not plausibly explain nodular-cystic evolution; replacement of established LCH by LAM is constructed as a disease transition.
findings.impact: Learner can exclude alternatives without applying longitudinal interpretation.
findings.required: Use plausible competing interpretations of nodular/cystic follow-up, with specific feedback and unchanged best-supported correct interpretation.
findings.retest: Actually reread Q09/Q10 all three languages after repair. Q09 now explicitly develops central airspaces in other pre-existing nodules; smoking-related emphysema competes with LCH evolution. Q10 competing emphysema/traction-related airway dilatation now have context-specific feedback. Correct interpretations and clinical restraint retained.

findings.location: FA immediate pleural surface wording in Q01/02/03 feedback and cards02/14
findings.observed: Repeated سطح مستقیم پلور is a literal calque rather than natural wording for immediately adjacent lung.
findings.impact: Less precise spatial teaching in Persian.
findings.required: Use natural wording for tissue immediately adjacent to pleura, and preserve the pleural-sparing versus pleural-involvement distinction.
findings.retest: Actually reread FA Q01 wrong feedback, Q02 explanation/wrong feedback, Q03 wrong feedback, card02 front/explanation, and card14/Take Home after-values. All now use natural immediately adjacent lung wording; the card02 front and explanation were also freshly verified after the author clarified their actual values. No remaining wording finding.

scientificReadResult: No incorrect key, polarity reversal, universal etiologic proof or unsupported numerical diagnostic rule found within this text-assessment pool. Basic pattern recognition and clinical-context questions provide useful differing tasks; no quota gap identified.

retest.method: Fresh esbuild bundle of canonical QUESTION_BANK and FLASHCARDS; each question entire object deepEqual actual snapshot, each card front/answer/explanation triad deepEqual. Source option permutation also read; correct option text and wrong-feedback pairings retained.
